title: CHROME STALLION — Full Length
description: Full-length original development of sketch B: futuristic West Coast x industrial funk. The signature bass cell recurs through changing harmony, a haunting voice melody, a displaced evolution, a half-time ORGANISM rupture where mechanical percussion takes over the riff rhythm, an evolved heavy return, a high-register machine payoff, and a warm coda.

sections.development: stretched first gesture of the riff, bass alone with sparse clock
the original sketch groove: G cells, Cm-D lift, tine stabs, voice cries, dive
signature cell over Eb/Cm/Eb/F; haunting voice melody enters
drums withdraw; voice melody slow over bowed chords and warm long bass roots; soft drums return
groove returns, bass edges machine; Eb cell displaced +0.5 beat against unchanged drums
half-time: bass becomes long machine notes while clock/tines/bars play the riff rhythm; 2-bar negative space (bow subharmonic + hum); stop-time return
full pocket returns evolved: G G Eb F G G Cm D cells, second voice hums harmony, melody fragment, machine bass
riff an octave up as machine, overtone-lane voice over held roots, growl cell and 5-semitone dive
warm riff fragments, voice resolves D5-Bb4-G4, sparse clock; one held G relaxes machine->warm inside the note; final tine G
